data.name: Flame-Forged Insight
data.passiveDescription: When Electro-Charged, Lunar-Charged, or Bloom is triggered, restore {{12//15//18//21//24}} Elemental Energy and increase Elemental Mastery by {{60//75//90//105//120}} for 15 seconds. This effect can be triggered once every 15s and can be triggered even when the equipping character is off-field.
